main_text.l: Eô tempore tota Germania arcibus & castellis impleta fuit, ex quibus se invicem deprædabantur, & quorum rudera hodieqve in montibus conspiciuntur.
Tandem electus fuit Imperator Rudolphus Comes Habsburgensis, a quo hodierna familia Austriaca originem ducit.
Carolus IV cum in Imperio ordinem constituit, qui ho-dieq; obtinet.

A.C. 1353. publicata Aurea Bulla, quæ est Lex Imperii Romano-Germanici perpetua. Sed idem Carolus IV. vehementer debilitavit Impe-rium telonibus & reditibus Electo-ribus oppignoratis, ut filium suum Wenceslaum Imperatorem crea-rent.

page.notes: The note "5. Ordinem constitutü sub Carolo IV." is spread over six short lines in the left margin, hyphenated as "Ordi-nem" and "constitu-tü". "tü" is doubtful: the mark over the u may be a tilde or a diaeresis [?]. Canon 9 is written as a paragraph, not a heading. "qui hodieq;" is a line-end split with the printed hyphen. "hodieqve" is printed as such. Faint show-through and stains are not transcribed.
